description: A 64-stage shift register that samples a voltage on every trigger and outputs whichever stage back you select

params.text: Holds the trigger back by 0 to 5 samples before the input is sampled, so a sequencer clocked from the same pulse has time to change first
Selects how many stages back from the newest sample the output is taken, 1 to 64
Scales the STAGE CV, -100% to +100%; with that jack empty it scales the STAGE knob instead, fully clockwise pinning the output to the newest sample and fully anticlockwise reaching twice as far back

inputs.text: A trigger here samples the IN voltage into the register and moves every stored value along one place
The voltage sampled into the register on each trigger
Moves the selected stage, 0-10V covering all 64, scaled by the trimpot above it and added to the STAGE knob

outputs.text: The voltage held in the selected stage of the register

menu: Initialize on Start — empties the register and returns to the first stage when Rack loads a patch, instead of restoring what was stored

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
